items.title: Seven-court padel club planned for former warehouse in Mold
items.summary: The Lob Padel Club has applied to Flintshire County Council to change Unit 1 on Stephen Gray Road, Bromfield Industrial Estate, from industrial/storage to leisure use for an indoor centre with five doubles and two singles courts (including wheelchair-accessible courts), plus café and shop. The unit sits on protected employment land; the landlord's marketing report said three of seven enquiries for it came from padel operators.

items.title: Play Padel's new club at Sheffield's Meadowhall to open soon
items.summary: Play Padel Group will open its second venue at Meadowhall shopping centre at the end of October with eight indoor courts (one singles, seven doubles), cafe, bar and warm-up gym. It is offering 100 founding memberships at £99 for 12 months.

items.title: Padel clubs and self-employed coaches: legal guidance
items.summary: Myerson Solicitors sets out employment-status risks for operators engaging coaches as self-employed: if a tribunal or HMRC reclassifies them, clubs face backdated holiday pay, minimum wage, pension and tax exposure.

items.title: UK PADEL opens at Willen Lake on 17 October — Milton Keynes gets six more courts
items.summary: Four covered all-weather courts and two open-air courts, with daily social mix-in sessions.

items.title: Scottish Open Padel Championships streamed live on BBC iPlayer
items.summary: Finals from the inaugural Glasgow event went out on BBC iPlayer — a step up in mainstream visibility for UK padel.

items.title: Padel courts planned for Lancing leisure centre
items.summary: South Downs Leisure has applied to Adur District Council to replace an astroturf pitch at Lancing Manor Leisure Centre with three floodlit padel courts; the LTA has endorsed the plan. Decision deadline is 12 November 2026.

items.title: Four covered padel courts proposed at Birchwood Park Golf and Country Club, Dartford
items.summary: A planning application to Dartford council would remove driving range bays at Birchwood Park in Wilmington to make way for four covered padel courts, an outdoor terrace and a redirected public footpath.

items.title: Structuring padel leases for growth: five key points for operators
items.summary: Legal briefing on how operators should structure leases when expanding.

items.title: The Padel Club raises £3m to triple its footprint
items.summary: Wilmslow-founded operator takes NPIF II / PXN backing to fund eight new sites (Chester, Liverpool, Knutsford, Sheffield, Cardiff, Brighton, Sutton Coldfield), taking it to 85 courts. Reports roughly 100% revenue growth in H1 2026.

items.title: The Bath curse is broken — but padel “must do more to change the narrative”
items.summary: Smash Padel's Rupert Taylor on the Bath opening and the perception problem the industry still has.

items.title: Empower Padel and LTA launch programme to boost women's padel
items.summary: Joint participation programme targeting women and girls.

items.title: Padel Social Club secures £5.5m to open three new London venues
items.summary: Clark Group, Active Partners and Stormzy back 17 new courts at Paddington, Kentish Town and The O2. Its Earls Court site runs above 95% peak-time occupancy across 30,000+ players.
